heading_en: Measures against Risks Arising from Credit Risk Mitigation Techniques
summary_ja: 信用リスク削減手法の利用に伴い発生し得るリスクへの適切な対応措置を求める。
summary_en: Firms must manage the residual risks that using credit risk mitigation can create.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach shall compare the case where credit risk mitigation techniques are used with the case where they are not, and shall take measures to deal appropriately with the risks that may arise where credit risk mitigation techniques are used.
